howto.name: Upload an AVI file
howto.text: Drop an .avi file up to 500 MB. AVI is a legacy container, often carrying DivX or Xvid video.

howto.name: PrivaTools re-encodes via FFmpeg
howto.text: The legacy stream, often DivX or Xvid, is re-encoded as VP9.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. The video is re-encoded as VP9 WebM, which plays natively in modern browsers and is usually far smaller than the AVI it replaces.

faq.a: To turn an old AVI clip into a small, web-ready, open-format video. WebM (VP9/Opus) re-encodes the AVI for efficient browser playback.
Usually significantly — modern WebM is far more efficient than typical legacy AVI codecs.
Yes — local FFmpeg conversion; files deleted after the response.
